articles.headline: Mavericks' Cooper Flagg out for home opener with mild left shoulder sprain
articles.description: Mavericks star forward Cooper Flagg had an MRI that revealed a mild left shoulder sprain, the team announced. He will not play against the Spurs.

articles.headline: 76ers' LeBron James to sit vs. Bucks in first game of back-to-back
articles.description: LeBron James will miss the Sixers' game against the Bucks to manage low back pain/sciatica. It will be his first missed game of the season.

articles.headline: Magic's Paolo Banchero has ankle sprain; out multiple weeks, sources say
articles.description: Magic star Paolo Banchero has sustained a low-grade high ankle sprain, the team announced, with sources telling ESPN that the forward will miss multiple weeks.

articles.headline: Ex-NBA player Malik Beasley negotiating plea deal in gambling case
articles.description: Former NBA player Malik Beasley is negotiating a plea agreement with Department of Justice lawyers over his alleged role in a bribery and betting scheme, one of his attorneys confirmed.
